describe: The image shows a black ornamental iron trim: a diamond-shaped lattice of thin black bars across the top, with faint dark purple edges along the bars, and a solid black arch band below. Its openings and a large round arch are flat mid-grey. A small dark rust-brown block sits at the centre of the lattice. Contrast is high between black and grey. The grey openings are probably transparent areas shown on grey, so the trim is the only object.
